mechanism: Phenytoin is a potent CYP3A4/2C9/2C19 inducer that may reduce varenicline levels, while varenicline may inhibit phenytoin metabolism through CYP2C9, creating bidirectional interaction potential with altered seizure control risk.
action: Monitor phenytoin levels closely and watch for breakthrough seizure activity; varenicline dose adjustment or alternative smoking cessation agent may be necessary if seizure control becomes inadequate.
